test_title: PYST 23: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the father of B’

‘A - B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’

Based on the above, how is P related to T if ‘P - Q ÷ R + S × T’?
solution:

Given: P - Q ÷ R + S × T

It means: P is the mother of Q, Q is the brother of R, R is the father of S, S is the sister of T

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c60d2d5f48b97ef231e6984ef834b0a37dbf453ff1d84d239211cbdefd0d904a.png] 

Thus, P is T's Father’s mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
